name: UGC 7983 (Hubble)
blurb: UGC 7983, a dwarf irregular galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ugc7983-hubble
story: A dwarf irregular galaxy, a kind thought to resemble the very earliest galaxies in the universe. Hubble caught it in a wider effort to observe every known galaxy close to the Milky Way.

claims.text: UGC 7983 is a dwarf irregular galaxy, a type thought to be similar to the very earliest galaxies
UGC 7983 was observed as part of an effort to observe every known galaxy close to the Milky Way
UGC-07983 was a target of Hubble program 15922, Every Known Nearby Galaxy
ESA/Hubble picture of UGC 7983 is at RA 12 49 46.95, Dec +3 50 35.20, ACS 606 nm and 814 nm
